mapper.sql: id AS id, app_id AS appId, device_id AS deviceId, platform AS platform, kind AS kind, name AS name, message AS message, stack AS stack, page_url AS pageUrl, trace_id AS traceId, app_version AS appVersion, build_version AS buildVersion, os AS os, os_version AS osVersion, brand AS brand, model AS model, network_type AS networkType, fatal AS fatal, extra AS extra, occurred_at AS occurredAt, fingerprint AS fingerprint, dedup_hash AS dedupHash, add_time AS addTime

id AS id, app_id AS appId, fingerprint AS fingerprint, platform AS platform, kind AS kind, name AS name, title AS title, sample_message AS sampleMessage, sample_stack AS sampleStack, sample_device_id AS sampleDeviceId, sample_trace_id AS sampleTraceId, event_count AS eventCount, affected_devices AS affectedDevices, first_seen AS firstSeen, last_seen AS lastSeen, status_flag AS statusFlag, reopen_count AS reopenCount, last_fix_note AS lastFixNote, assignee AS assignee, close_note AS closeNote, llm_summary AS llmSummary, llm_severity AS llmSeverity, add_time AS addTime
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO logan_error (app_id, device_id, platform, kind, name, message, stack, page_url, trace_id, app_version, build_version, os, os_version, brand, model, network_type, fatal, extra, occurred_at, fingerprint, dedup_hash, add_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{deviceId}, #{platform}, #{kind}, #{name}, #{message}, #{stack}, #{pageUrl}, #{traceId}, #{appVersion}, #{buildVersion}, #{os}, #{osVersion}, #{brand}, #{model}, #{networkType}, #{fatal}, #{extra}, #{occurredAt}, #{fingerprint}, #{dedupHash}, #{addTime})

INSERT INTO logan_error_issue (app_id, fingerprint, platform, kind, name, title, sample_message, sample_stack, sample_device_id, sample_trace_id, event_count, affected_devices, first_seen, last_seen, status_flag, reopen_count, add_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{fingerprint}, #{platform}, #{kind}, #{name}, #{title}, #{sampleMessage}, #{sampleStack}, #{sampleDeviceId}, #{sampleTraceId}, #{eventCount}, #{affectedDevices}, #{firstSeen}, #{lastSeen}, #{statusFlag}, #{reopenCount}, #{addTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = event_count + 1, sample_message = COALESCE(VALUES(sample_message), sample_message), sample_stack = COALESCE(VALUES(sample_stack), sample_stack), sample_device_id = VALUES(sample_device_id), sample_trace_id = VALUES(sample_trace_id), title = VALUES(title), kind = VALUES(kind), platform = VALUES(platform), last_seen = GREATEST(last_seen, VALUES(last_seen)), first_seen = LEAST(first_seen, VALUES(first_seen)), affected_devices = VALUES(affected_devices)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM logan_error_issue WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM logan_error_issue WHERE (llm_summary IS NULL OR llm_summary = '') AND ( (sample_stack IS NOT NULL AND sample_stack != '') OR (sample_message IS NOT NULL AND sample_message != '') ) ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_error_issue SET llm_summary = #{llmSummary}, llm_severity = #{llmSeverity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE logan_error_issue SET assignee = #{assignee} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE logan_error_issue SET close_note = #{closeNote} WHERE id = #{id}
